name: XSL Script Processing
description: Adversaries may bypass application control and obscure execution of code by embedding scripts inside XSL files. Extensible Stylesheet Language (XSL) files are commonly used to describe the processing and rendering of data within XML files. To support complex operations, the XSL standard includes support for embedded scripting in various languages. Adversaries may abuse this functionality to execute arbitrary files while potentially bypassing application control.
